title: Componentwise normalized coefficient evaluation projection
statement: Fix l, E, W and reduction data R with evaluation tensor normalization hE. For normalized M, n, any adjunction L ⊣ coefficientSequenceDerivedEvaluation n and P, and every q, the finite evaluation of the unit-defined projection is an isomorphism.

source.place: Construction 4.1 and Proposition 4.17(a), component calculation before joint evaluation detection.

proof.text: Apply coefficientNormalizedSequence_semilinear: its proved transition identification and adjunction/coyoneda argument convert the coefficient universal Hom-bijection criterion to semilinear normalization for the selected scalar models.

Use the canonical total evaluation comparison. Its pure-generator formula and the unique characterization of coefficientEvaluationTensorIso identify it with the prescribed coefficient chain isomorphism. The total comparison summand equation supplies the ordinary-normalized chain field, and evaluation preserves the flat-term K-flat representative class. Cancel the isomorphisms in the representative square hE to obtain the inverse derived square of TensorComparisonModel for the actual R.evaluationTensor.

Choose the existing normalized scalar-derived models for the finite coefficient maps and apply semilinearCartesianProjection to the actual closed tensor structures and the preceding evaluation model. This proves invertibility of the whole unit-defined projection with precisely the given L, adjunction, P and R.evaluationTensor.
Apply Functor.map_isIso to exact derived evaluation at q. This gives the displayed component isomorphism for every q, with no case split repeated in this module.

lean.statement:
theorem coefficientNormalizedEvaluationProjection_components
    (R : CoefficientDerivedSystemReduction l E W)
    (hE : CoefficientEvaluationTensorNormalization l E W R)
    (M : coefficientSequenceDerived l E W)
    (hM : IsNormalizedCoefficientSequence l E W M) (n : ℕ)
    (L : normalizedDVRDerived l E W n ⥤ coefficientSequenceDerived l E W)
    (adj : L ⊣ coefficientSequenceDerivedEvaluation l E W n)
    (P : normalizedDVRDerived l E W n) (q : ℕ) :
    IsIso ((coefficientSequenceDerivedEvaluation l E W q).map
      ((adj.homEquiv _ _).symm
        ((R.finiteClosed n).tensor.map
            (Prod.mkHom (adj.unit.app P)
              (𝟙 ((coefficientSequenceDerivedEvaluation l E W n).obj M))) ≫
          (R.evaluationTensor n).inv.app (L.obj P, M))))
